chunks: And [they are] those who direct affairs by command,
ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'Al-Mudabbirat Amran' mean in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia tafsir, this phrase is frequently interpreted as referring to the angels who organize cosmic affairs, with some scholars extending the concept to the Imams as the divine administrators of creation. The term 'al-mudabbirat' highlights the active, orderly management of the universe under God's sole authority, reinforcing the Shia emphasis on the structured hierarchy of divine guidance.
